text:
Jamie Drysdale is playing 23.17 minutes a night, and lately closer to 24, which makes him the Flyers' workhorse at 24 years old. The sixth pick in 2020 has eight points in 18 games, three of them in one 6-3 win over Utah, and his scoring pace sits right where his talent range says it should.

The concerning part is the 5v5 picture. Philadelphia gets only 38 percent of the shot attempts and 38 percent of the expected goals with him on the ice, and that's 5.45 points worse than without him. He's also benefiting from good on-ice shooting, 3.5 goals above what the chances deserve, which is propping up his points.

Some of that is deployment and some is the team. Still, the minutes keep growing, and a defenseman who spends that much time defending will be judged on whether those numbers move. Watch his blocked shots (30 already) as a sign of how often the Flyers are pinned.
headline: Drysdale is carrying a heavy load in Philadelphia
